g.title: wc3_action_documents
g.text: Upload images, videos, and files to Action records

a.xlink:title: File upload pipeline — checksum, inline encode, EXIF extract, virus scan, create Document. Service: apps/docs/views_upload.py Functions: upload_view @ apps/docs/views_upload.py:46 (inline encoding: zlib+base64 for small files) checksum computation @ apps/docs/views_upload.py:73 (SHA256 dedup check)

File storage — images, videos, PDFs. Inline-encoded in config or external path. EXIF extraction, virus scan. Model: apps/docs/models/document.py:22 Functions: Document.increment_access @ apps/docs/models/document.py:76 (atomic access counter + history)
LinkageEntry child — document attached to action. Same group_id as parent. Model: apps/docs/models/linkage_entry.py:28

LinkageEntry parent — clusters action with its attached documents via group_id. Model: apps/docs/models/linkage_entry.py:28 Functions: LinkageEntry.next_group_id @ apps/docs/models/linkage_entry.py:100 (generates next group_id for clustering)

Universal task — who, what, why, when, where, how. References any record. Tracks communication touches. Model: apps/core/models/action.py:10 Functions: Action._pending_attachments @ apps/core/models/action.py:198 (pre_save captures attachment list) Action.post_save (linkage) @ apps/core/models/action.py:230 (creates LinkageEntry group for documents) Action.contact_id resolve @ apps/core/models/action.py:285 (auto-resolves contact from assigned_to)
